card.name: Bare numerals in section references and units
card.fires_on: The digit 2 (or 3, 8) inside label markup: section-reference numbers in parentheses after dosing statements, the 2 in mg/m2, and the number in temperature ranges. Also the word vitro in 'in vitro'.

modes.label: Section reference number
modes.description: A digit inside parentheses that closes a highlighted dosing instruction, pointing to a label section.
modes.example: apply a thin layer once or twice daily to the affected areas. ( <<2>> )

modes.label: Superscript 2 in units
modes.description: The 2 in body-surface-area units such as mg/m2 in dose rates.
modes.example: to a maximum rate of 1.75 mg/m <<2>> /hour.

modes.label: Temperature range number
modes.description: The upper number in a Celsius storage range.
modes.example: Infusion solutions stored at 2 °C to <<8>> °C Protected from light

card.writes: It promotes whitespace and tab tokens, which suggests it sets up spacing or table-like layout after the number.
